title: Farming Mod
body:
farming mod is a mod i guess which is in development but adds cool things to improve farming(sickles, hydrator, etc.)

please remember this mod was intended for _1.21.11_
this mod right now DOES NOT add any crops, but soon will(if it does i forgot to update desc)


## **Sickles**
Sickles are tools to help you harvest crops, for example a iron sickle breaks all crops in a range of 6 blocks.

- Stone Sickle
![stone sickle png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d95ee3c4c8e122b56bffc51a5c875d26453f7e2_0.webp)

    Range: 3 blocks each direction

    Crafting:

    ![CRAFTING RECIPE STONE SICKLE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b54c5563c7679414f6c73fe14c79dcffa98c1c40.png)

- Iron Sickle
![iron sickle png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7154b2890ffe3a58f8d43015a6c12671879eab4_0.webp)

    Range: 6 blocks each direction

    Crafting:

    ![CRAFTING IRON SICKLE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12516e0ee9d694526d16add564239d7ecb8169c2.png)

- Gold Sickle
  ![gold sickle png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f99f3237929cde18c322b63a2f40e79b532c8a28_0.webp)

    Range: 9 blocks each direction

    Crafting:

    ![CRAFTING GOLD SICKLE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbf1e3d9ecff2b8edd7a1e3d21730ed92b6907ee.png)
- Sadly as of right now, netherite and diamond sickles DO NOT exist

## **Hydrators**
Hydrator is a slight upgrade and degrade from regular water bucket, to moisture farmland nearby

![HYDRATORPNG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dbc5435c5eddc6f3d3d0459dd3f1ad69abff28c.png)![HYDRATORPNG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dbc5435c5eddc6f3d3d0459dd3f1ad69abff28c.png)
![HYDRATORPNG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dbc5435c5eddc6f3d3d0459dd3f1ad69abff28c.png)



### Comparson to regular water

Water:
- Can be above farmland
- Cannot be under farmland
- Can be at the same Y level as farmland
- Hydrates 4 farmland blocks every direction

Hydrator:
- Cannot be above farmland
- Can be at the same Y level as farmland
- Can be under farmland
- Hydrates 6 farmland blocks every direction

WARNING: HYDRATORS CAN BE LAGGY

### Crafting

![HYDRATOR CRAFT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37412710b8fe743014101ee6c41a6f7fe90b3735.png)

this crafting can work with any type of wood, but only cobblestone. after crafting keeps the iron bucket in recipe but empty


# About tomatoes
Tomatoes are a new crop i added, and they do work really similarly to carrots. their MAX AGE is 4, and they are like a seed and food at the same time(like potatoes and carrots and more)

## **Tomatoes**
You can find tomatoes in glasshouses which is covered below.

so ill use this for photos

## **Glasshouses**
They are a kinda common structure. but to find one you have to be a plains biome(they spawn only there!!!!)
Every glasshouse should have 2 barrels, each having some tomatoes.
Theyre more like ruined glasshouses but thats my original idea so dont mind if the structure looks **[[Damaged]]**

![GLASSHOUSE_PREVIEW](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/016a8f86650622ef258c5821ede3291a3424de75_0.webp)

## **Ketchup**
Ketchup is a new food item(more like sauce item i guess) which does nothing for now, but might be useful in future updates for even more food items XD

They can be crafted using some sugar and tomatoes.
